concerns.text: FR-001 cross‑reference "(See US-1)" points to a non‑existent identifier; user stories are labeled "User Story 1" etc., not "US-1".
FR-002 also references "(See US-1)" which does not exist; the same undefined identifier appears in FR-003, FR-004, FR-005, FR-006, and FR-007 (US‑2/US‑3).
Inconsistent dataset naming: the requirement uses "DefectsJ" while the idea section, assumptions, and elsewhere use the correct "Defects4J".
Statistical test mismatch: the idea section specifies paired Wilcoxon signed‑rank tests, but FR-004 mandates McNemar's tests for accuracy and LME models for speed, creating contradictory methodology.
Reproducibility RAM limit conflict: the idea block states the analysis must run with ≤4 GB RAM, whereas FR-007 permits up to ≤7 GB RAM.
